purpose: Line-by-line re-read of every curated row at its own official product URL. Each row records the page it was read from, the values the seller printed, the verdict, and the verbatim quote the verdict rests on.

method.automated: 48 of 59 official product pages were retrieved and parsed by scripts/live_reverify.mjs on a GitHub Actions runner (full internet access).
method.manual: 3 rows were read by hand where the automated runner was blocked, or where the full variant set mattered.

corrections.why: Full sizes are $849 and half sizes are $799 in the seller's own variant feed. The row stored a single $849.

corrections.quote: CLEARANCE 29% Off $1,795 $1,269 ; variant feed: Size 5 1439.00, Size 6 1439.00, Size 6.5 1439.00
corrections.why: The page shows a $1,269 sale price on the default variant, and the seller's variant feed lists $1,439 for other sizes.
Mejuri publishes a $1,100–$1,700 range in its own structured data; the row stored only the starting price.
